title: The Safe Send

context.wallet: Safe{Wallet} web (app.safe.global) + MetaMask extension as the owner's signer
context.settings: app.safe.global prod defaults · 1-of-1 Safe · execute immediately

_comment: Safe{Wallet} web, 1-of-1 Safe on mainnet, plain ETH send, executed at once. Code-traced from safe-global/safe-wallet-monorepo@7137337 and safe-global/safe-client-gateway@158f5db; live capture pending. The browser talks to one Safe host, the Client Gateway (CGW, safe-client.safe.global); the Transaction Service, Config Service and Decoder sit behind it. CGW forwards no client IP or headers upstream. The Safe{Wallet} RPC host and the gas oracle host come from the CGW chain config at runtime and are not in either repo: written as unknown. With threshold 1 there is no off-chain signature: Safe{Wallet} proposes the unsigned SafeTx to CGW, then asks MetaMask to sign and send execTransaction; MetaMask's own steps are inherited from m1. New carry: safe_address (the Safe, as opposed to selected_address, the owner).

worst_lie.note: the served frontend builds the SafeTx you sign

provenance.ref: safe-wallet-monorepo@7137337 apps/web (Next.js static app); same-origin probe HEAD /swap at apps/web/src/components/common/GeoblockingProvider/index.tsx:8
